key_insight: Random data splits can reward recipe memorisation, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise to unseen perovskite solar-cell research.
engineering_relevance: Reliable device optimisation requires models that account for architecture and fabrication as well as absorber chemistry.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits, while composition-aware neural models excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Implementation depends on reliable recipe and provenance metadata, and the abstract provides no numerical performance margins.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
